title: NotificationMessage
description: Generic notification payload produced by the rule engine, consumed by channel-specific notifiers (Teams, Mail). The notifier translates this to its native format (e.g., Adaptive Card).

channel.description: Logical channel name. The dispatcher selects the adapter based on this value.

recipients.description: Channel-specific recipient identifiers. For Teams, a channel URL or name; for Mail, email addresses.

subject.description: One-line subject. Used as the email subject or Teams card title.

body.description: Plain-text or markdown body. Channel-specific rendering applies.

actions.description: Optional action links (e.g., 'Open in SecureOps' deep link).

facts.description: Key/value facts rendered in card-style notifications.
